title: Core Duo #20
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Romanian woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, long dark-brown hair in glossy voluminous waves, an intense, proud expression, cool and composed, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain — a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin, sultry, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern — a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 landscape 8K.
